raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Under a true-on-policy contract (e.g. `qwen3_dense_true_on_policy_v1`), the lm head runs in bf16 and eager forward returns bf16 next-token logits. CUDA-graph decode copies the same logits into the shared `next_token_logits_buffer`, which was always fp32. As a result, decode `log_softmax` and top-k ran in fp32 and stopped matching the trainer bitwise. Prefill, which uses no buffer, matched. In `LogitsProcessor._copy_logits_to_buffer`, the buffer branch came before the force-bf16 branch, so the bf16 cast never ran under CUDA graph.

The fix gives the buffer the dtype the logits processor returns:
- `get_next_token_logits_dtype(config)` in `logits_processor.py` returns bf16 when the contract forces a bf16 lm head, and fp32 otherwise.
- `GraphSharedOutput.get_logits_buffer` takes a required `dtype` and keys its cache by `(vocab_size, dtype)`.
- Every runner that allocates a `next_token_logits_buffer` passes that dtype: decode and prefill CUDA graph, EAGLE and multi-layer EAGLE draft extend, and the base runner's dummy-run buffers.
- `_copy_logits_to_buffer` asserts that the buffer dtype matches, so a mismatched allocation fails loudly instead of converting silently.
- Default serving is unchanged and keeps the fp32 buffer.

An alternative was rejected: checking for force-bf16 before the buffer branch would drop the shared buffer, so each captured batch size would hold its own logits output. With this fix the shared buffer stays, and halves in size under the contract.

Only `sglang-miles` needs this. On `main`, `_copy_logits_to_buffer` upcasts every path to fp32, so prefill and decode already agree.

## Rebased onto the rebuilt sglang-miles (`bff3f6ae7e`)

The rebuilt branch adds a fused cast-and-softcap path in `_copy_logits_to_buffer` that always writes fp32 logits and asserts an fp32 buffer. `get_next_token_logits_dtype` therefore returns fp32 when the config sets `final_logit_softcapping`, and the softcap lookup is shared through `_final_logit_softcapping(config)`. The unit test adds a contract-plus-softcap case. The GPU results below were measured before the rebase; the CPU unit tests were re-run on the new base:
- the new tests: 6 passed (plus 5 subtests);
- `true_on_policy/` and the logprob suites: no new failures. The 10 failures and 1 error also fail on base, from stub subprocesses and missing CUDA.

## GPU validation of the current head (`7b6ae42fef`, 2026-10-21)

Run with Qwen3-4B on 2x H200, with CUDA graph on, using the radixark/miles#4109 checks (k=128, 3 rollouts):

| Run | SGLang | Result | top-k logprob diff / set mismatch | `train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| top-k, native `/generate` | this PR | pass | 0 / 0 every rollout | 0 |
| top-k, session (flat base64, 48/48 records) | this PR | pass | 0 / 0 every rollout | 0 |
| existing `test_qwen3_4B_fsdp_true_on_policy.py` | this PR | pass | n/a | 0 every step |
| top-k, native `/generate` | base `bff3f6ae7e` | fails, as expected | 0.109 / 0.995 | n/a |

GPU unit tests (`unit/true_on_policy/`, `unit/spec/`, `unit/layers/test_logprob_*`): the only difference from base is the new `test_graph_logits_buffer_dtype.py`, which passes 4/4. The same 10 tests fail on both commits: `test_dense_deterministic_math` (3) and `test_on_policy_wiring` subprocesses (7).

## Results

Qwen3-4B, 2x H200. Measured on `sglang-miles` `4076a6857` plus this commit, which applies unchanged on top of `7b6993a31`.

- **miles true-on-policy CI** (FSDP, k=128; radixark/miles#3952 and its follow-up CI test). The trainer scores SGLang's recorded top-k candidates with the same weights. Values are max |trainer - SGLang| over the candidates / fraction of tokens whose candidate set differs:

  | Rollout path | CUDA graph on, before | CUDA graph on, after |
  |---|---|---|
  | native `/generate` | 0.109 / 0.995 | 0 / 0 |
  | session chat (flat b64 top logprobs) | 0.109 / 0.995 | 0 / 0 |

  With `--disable-cuda-graph`, both runs were already 0 before the fix. The existing `test_qwen3_4B_fsdp_true_on_policy.py` passes, with `train_rollout_logprob_abs_diff` 0.
- **SGLang decode vs prefill rescore** (raw floats, 8 prompts, 1,221 decode tokens, top-20):

  | Contract on, CUDA graph | sampled logprob bitwise equal | top-20 rows equal |
  |---|---|---|
  | before | 418 / 1221 | 52 / 1221 |
  | after | 1221 / 1221 | 1221 / 1221 |

- **Throughput** (64 x 512 tokens): with the contract, 7,186 to 7,264 tok/s. Without the contract, 13,343 to 13,249 tok/s (noise), and the output is bitwise identical to before.
- **Memory:** decode graph capture uses 1.22 GB instead of 1.30 GB. KV capacity is unchanged.

## Tests

- New: `test/registered/unit/true_on_policy/test_graph_logits_buffer_dtype.py` (CPU). It checks that buffer and no-buffer logits are bitwise equal and bf16 under the contract, stay fp32 by default and with an fp32 lm head, and that buffers are keyed by dtype.
- Passing on the GPU box: the new test, `test_logprob_chunk_stitching`, `test_logprob_fast_input`, `test_prefill_cuda_graph_runner`, `test_mlp_sync_pad_unpad`, `test_eagle_draft_extend_logits`, `test_lm_head_pruning`, `test_elastic_cuda_graph_setup`.
- `test_on_policy_wiring.py` and `test_dense_deterministic_math.py` show the same failures with and without this commit on that box; their stub subprocess scripts crash there.
- pre-commit passes on the changed files.

+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import (
+    LogitsMetadata,
+    LogitsProcessor,
+    get_next_token_logits_dtype,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.graph_shared_output import GraphSharedOutput
+from sglang.srt.true_on_policy import QWEN3_DENSE_TRUE_ON_POLICY_V1
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="stage-a-test-cpu")
+
+_SERVER_ARGS_TARGET = "sglang.srt.true_on_policy.config._get_global_server_args"
+_GET_EXEC_TARGET = "sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor.get_exec"
+
+VOCAB = 37
+ROWS = 4
+
+
+def _server_args(*, contract):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        rl_on_policy_target=None, true_on_policy_contract=contract, tp_size=1
+    )
+
+
+def _exec(*, enable_fp32_lm_head=False):
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        features=SimpleNamespace(enable_fp32_lm_head=enable_fp32_lm_head)
+    )
+
+
+def _copy_logits(config, logits, logits_buffer):
+    processor = LogitsProcessor.__new__(LogitsProcessor)
+    processor.vocab_size = config.vocab_size
+    processor.next_token_logits_dtype = get_next_token_logits_dtype(config)
+    metadata = LogitsMetadata(
+        forward_mode=ForwardMode.DECODE, next_token_logits_buffer=logits_buffer
+    )
+    return processor._copy_logits_to_buffer(logits, metadata)
+
+
+class TestGraphLogitsBufferDtype(unittest.TestCase):
+    """CUDA-graph replay copies logits into the shared buffer, eager forward does
+    not; both must hand the sampler identical logits, or true-on-policy top-k and
+    sampled-token logprobs drift from the trainer on decode only."""
+
+    def _graph_and_eager_logits(
+        self, *, contract, enable_fp32_lm_head=False, final_logit_softcapping=None
+    ):
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            vocab_size=VOCAB, final_logit_softcapping=final_logit_softcapping
+        )
+        logits = torch.randn(ROWS, VOCAB).to(torch.bfloat16)
+        with (
+            patch(_SERVER_ARGS_TARGET, return_value=_server_args(contract=contract)),
+            patch(
+                _GET_EXEC_TARGET,
+                return_value=_exec(enable_fp32_lm_head=enable_fp32_lm_head),
+            ),
+        ):
+            shared = GraphSharedOutput(device=torch.device("cpu"), max_rows=ROWS)
+            logits_buffer = shared.get_logits_buffer(
+                VOCAB, rows=ROWS, dtype=get_next_token_logits_dtype(config)
+            )
+            graph = _copy_logits(config, logits, logits_buffer)
+            eager = _copy_logits(config, logits, None)
+        self.assertEqual(graph.data_ptr(), logits_buffer.data_ptr())
+        return graph, eager
+
+    def test_true_on_policy_graph_logits_match_eager_bf16(self):
+        graph, eager = self._graph_and_eager_logits(
+            contract=QWEN3_DENSE_TRUE_ON_POLICY_V1
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(graph.dtype, torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertEqual(eager.dtype, torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(graph, eager))
+        self.assertTrue(
+            torch.equal(torch.log_softmax(graph, -1), torch.log_softmax(eager, -1))
+        )
+
+    def test_default_fp32_lm_head_and_softcap_keep_fp32_buffer(self):
+        # A logit softcap is fused with an fp32 cast, so the buffer stays fp32 under the contract.
+        for contract, enable_fp32_lm_head, softcap in (
+            (None, False, None),
+            (QWEN3_DENSE_TRUE_ON_POLICY_V1, True, None),
+            (QWEN3_DENSE_TRUE_ON_POLICY_V1, False, 30.0),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(
+                contract=contract, fp32_lm_head=enable_fp32_lm_head, softcap=softcap
+            ):
+                graph, eager = self._graph_and_eager_logits(
+                    contract=contract,
+                    enable_fp32_lm_head=enable_fp32_lm_head,
+                    final_logit_softcapping=softcap,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(graph.dtype, torch.float)
+                self.assertEqual(eager.dtype, torch.float)
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(graph, eager))
+
+    def test_multi_layer_eagle_draft_extend_buffer_follows_logits_dtype(self):
+        # This runner owns its next_token_logits_buffer and holds per-step runners,
+        # not a model_runner of its own.
+        from sglang.srt.speculative import (
+            multi_layer_eagle_draft_extend_cuda_graph_runner as runner_module,
+        )
+
+        model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            hf_text_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                vocab_size=VOCAB, final_logit_softcapping=None
+            ),
+        )
+        runner = object.__new__(
+            runner_module.MultiLayerEagleMultiStepDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner
+        )
+        runner.runners = [
+            None,
+            SimpleNamespace(model_runner=SimpleNamespace(model_config=model_config)),
+        ]
+        runner.max_bs = 2
+        runner.captured_req_width = 2
+        runner.seq_len_fill_value = 1
+        runner.device = "cpu"
+        runner.prune_draft_extend_logits = False
+        runner.rotates_in_graph = False
+        runner.require_gathered_buffer = False
+        runner._vocab_size = lambda: VOCAB
+        with (
+            patch(
+                _SERVER_ARGS_TARGET,
+                return_value=_server_args(contract=QWEN3_DENSE_TRUE_ON_POLICY_V1),
+            ),
+            patch(_GET_EXEC_TARGET, return_value=_exec()),
+            patch.object(
+                runner_module,
+                "get_draft_input_from_target_hidden_dim",
+                return_value=8,
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                runner_module,
+                "get_exec",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                    mamba=SimpleNamespace(enable_mamba_extra_buffer=False)
+                ),
+            ),
+        ):
+            buffers = runner._allocate_buffers()
+        self.assertEqual(buffers.next_token_logits_buffer.dtype, torch.bfloat16)
+
+    def test_shared_buffer_is_keyed_by_dtype(self):
+        shared = GraphSharedOutput(device=torch.device("cpu"), max_rows=ROWS)
+        fp32 = shared.get_logits_buffer(VOCAB, rows=ROWS, dtype=torch.float)
+        bf16 = shared.get_logits_buffer(VOCAB, rows=2, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertEqual(fp32.dtype, torch.float)
+        self.assertEqual(bf16.dtype, torch.bfloat16)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            shared.get_logits_buffer(VOCAB, rows=ROWS, dtype=torch.bfloat16).data_ptr(),
+            bf16.data_ptr(),
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

When multi-layer EAGLE graph capture is enabled, this method runs on `MultiLayerEagleMultiStepDraftExtendCudaGraphRunner`, which never defines `self.model_runner`; that attribute exists only on each per-step runner. `_allocate_buffers()` has already bound `model_runner = runner.model_runner`, so this access raises `AttributeError` before any graph is captured for every multi-layer EAGLE run; obtain the config from that local runner instead.
